(Run the example standalone.)
1. Open a new browser tab and navigate to any webpage.
2. Copy and paste the address where you ran the standalone sample file into the browser tab from step 1 above.
3. On the new tab, select the filename above the createWindow() button.
4. Click the createWindow() button.
5. Create multiple windows using the above methods of Step 3 to Step 4.
6. Click the browser's Back button.
7. Confirm it navigates back to the initial webpage from step 1.
8. Click the browser's Forward button.
9. Confirm that you return to the sample screen with multiple windows created.
(When the `spaReplaceHistory=“false” setting is applied, the screen transitions at each window creation step.)
